promos.title: Free 55-inch Samsung TV with an S26 Ultra
promos.detail: Buy any S26 Ultra (256GB, 512GB or 1TB, without a phone plan) in Samsung Germany's online shop, add the Crystal UHD 55-inch TV and use code BF2026: the TV is free. Samsung Germany delivers only inside Germany. Same campaign also offers a free Samsung washing machine or washer-dryer instead (bundle listed with the 256GB model, code BF2026).

promos.title: 10% off with code BF26
promos.detail: 10% off at checkout on samsung.com/nl, calculated on the price after any other promotion. The same code also works on samsung.com/be.

promos.title: Free Watch 8 or Tab A11+ with a phone plan
promos.detail: Odido gives a Galaxy Watch 8, KPN and Vodafone a Galaxy Tab A11+ with the S26 Ultra. Only with a phone plan.

promos.title: 5% off orders of €1,000 or more
promos.detail: Samsung Italy online shop, on top of Black Friday prices.

promos.title: MediaMarkt Black Friday deals in the app
promos.detail: Deals appear in the app first and usually run until Cyber Monday.

promos.title: Samsung Italy Black Friday
promos.detail: Black Friday offers on samsung.com/it until 1 December, 09:00.

promos.title: Rewards points on samsung.com
promos.detail: Black Friday points on Galaxy S26 phones (e.g. €100 on the S26 512GB). Check the S26 Ultra page while logged in.

promos.title: Samsung cashback €250 on S26 Ultra (ended)
promos.detail: This €250 Samsung cashback applied to purchases between 8 June and 12 July 2026. Coolblue's Black Friday cashback (9-30 Nov) is only €150 on the Z Flip 8 and S26 FE, not the S26 Ultra.

promos.title: Birthday discount for Samsung Members
promos.detail: A birthday email with discounts that vary by product, up to 30%.

promos.title: 10% off for ICS credit card holders
promos.detail: Separate Samsung webshop for ICS cardholders. 10% off Samsung's own price, so usually not cheaper than shops.

promos.title: Free Galaxy Watch8 with an S26 Ultra (Partners Reward)
promos.detail: Samsung Italy's Watch8 gift for Partners Reward members ran from 6 October to 2 November 2026.
promos.who: For Samsung Partners Reward members in Italy. Ask your Italian colleagues to check their store.

promos.title: December employee-store gifts (expected)
promos.detail: Last year Samsung Italy ran Partners Reward promotions from 9 to 22 December with a free tablet or earbuds on Galaxy S and Z phones. A similar window is likely this year.
promos.who: For Samsung Partners Reward members in Italy. Ask your Italian colleagues to check their store.

promos.title: Corporate Benefits premium weeks
promos.detail: The German Corporate Benefits platform sometimes raises Samsung discounts, e.g. up to 38% instead of up to 28% during 15-21 May 2026.
promos.who: For employees of companies on Corporate Benefits Germany. Ask your German colleagues.

promos.title: Samsung EPP standard discount
promos.detail: Samsung Switzerland's employee store has a standard discount of at least 15% plus regular promotions. Importing to NL adds 21% VAT.
promos.who: For employees of Samsung EPP partner companies in Switzerland. Ask your Swiss colleagues.

alerts.text: Samsung.nl lowered the 512GB to €1,399; with code BF26 that's €1,259.10. Cheapest NL is still Amazon at €1,099.

Ends today 13:59: free TV or washing machine with an S26 Ultra in Samsung's German shop (code BF2026, Germany delivery only).
Amazon NL dropped to €1,099 for the 512GB (lowest in the Netherlands today). Still above your €900 budget.
Reminder: the free TV / washing machine with an S26 Ultra in Samsung's German shop (code BF2026) ends tomorrow 26 Nov at 13:59. Germany delivery only.
NL prices went up: lowest 512GB is now €1,159 at Belsimpel and Amazon NL (bol.com plaza €1,204.95).

Coolblue NL shows a €250 Samsung cashback badge on the S26 Ultra 512GB (€1,609). Conditions not confirmed yet.

Italy's Partners Reward Watch8 gift ended on 2 November.
